CURRENT SCENE:
古代的时候，有一个男人，他的名字是神农。他看到了有很多人不知道哪个植物好吃，也不知道什么植物对你的身体有好处。这个问题神农觉得很糟糕，所以神农去了吃每种植物。他吃了一种植物以后，就写了这个植物对你有没有好处。有的时候，神农吃了很好吃的植物。有的时候，他吃了很危险的植物。他吃完了每种植物以后，会来跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了。

ITEMS:

[I276] 【古代的时候】   correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 古代的时候 -> 在古代 (corrected 18/30 in train)
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]

[I277] 【他】的名字是神农   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: the story starts with a pronoun: introduce the character first
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: [-他]正好看神农
  her past correction: 神农回[-他的]家 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: [神农→他]可能会死 — her note: use他to replace神农，otherwise it is ambiguous, as if there are three persons referred here, in fact there are only two

[I278] 他看到了有很多人不知道哪【个】植物好吃   correction: 个 → 种   strength: error
  checker's note: plants are classified by 种 here
  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see
  her past correction: 他一[看→看到]植物就吃 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction: 神农发现[-了]大家都不知道什么植物能吃 — her note: 发现is a mental state verb, no了

[I279] 也不【知道】什么植物对你的身体有好处   correction: 知道 → 了解   strength: suggestion
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”

In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”

items.explanation: 古代 is the setting of the action, so use 在+Place: 在古代.
This character appears for the first time, so introduce him briefly with an identifying noun phrase, such as 有一个男人, before using his name or 他.
Plants are counted by type here, so use 种, not 个.
It would be more natural to say 了解 here when referring to knowing about which plants are good for the body.
This means people in general, not the listener. Use 人 instead of 你.
神农 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete the repeated subject. Chinese uses zero form here.
Do not put 了 between 去 and 吃. Delete 了 here.
It would be more natural to delete 吃 here and say 去 every kind of plant.
This refers to people in general, not the listener. Use 人 instead of 你.
聊 takes its topic directly, so delete 到: 聊他吃的植物.
会 shows a future or habitual action here, not a completed action, so do not use 了completed.
